entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is available as an official Hermes Agent provider through an Apache-2.0 self-hosted server, an OSS SDK, or a managed cloud service.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: This memory engine utilizes a custom vector graph engine to deliver sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for high-volume token processing. It unifies memory, RAG, and user profiles into a single API that supports multi-modal extraction from sources like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An open-source context database that employs the viking:// protocol and tiered L0/L1/L2 loading to optimize token expenditure. It demonstrates significant task-completion gains and provides observable retrieval trajectories to assist in debugging agent memory workflows.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain constructs a self-wiring knowledge graph using typed edges to synthesize answers with citations and gap analysis. It is designed for local deployment using PGLite to maintain a structured and searchable memory architecture.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: This system focuses on long-term memory through specialized retain, recall, and reflect workflows that allow agents to learn over time. It offers Python and Node.js SDKs alongside Docker-based deployment options for integrating persistent memory into agentic stacks.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Serving as the upstream library for specialized Hermes wrappers, this library enables stateful agents through peer-centric modeling and background reasoning. It can be deployed as a managed service or a self-hosted FastAPI server with support for Python and TypeScript.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This provider treats memory like a git repository, offering version control features such as commits, branches, and merges over a markdown context tree. It features a 5-tier retrieval system with sub-100ms performance and an interactive TUI powered by React/Ink.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer system organizes memory into a Ground Truth hierarchy that includes persistent Qdrant vector search, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It relies on local infrastructure like Docker, Redis, and SQLite to ensure agents prioritize specifically injected context.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: This recursive self-improving context harness uses filesystem-first traces and reports to help agents navigate complex tasks. It includes CLI tools for simulating and investigating tasks, supporting both Pi and MCP clients for context management.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a DAG-based engine to ensure no messages are lost within the agent's history. It stores data in SQLite with FTS metadata and builds depth-aware summary nodes to facilitate efficient searching and expansion of context.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides private cross-session memory for Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM provider or local inference servers for persistent state management.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur offers a shared memory layer that stores data as plain-text YAML engrams for multi-agent systems. It enables local-first, zero-cost search and supports MCP tools like Claude Code and Cursor.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet provides a local-first identity and secrets layer that ensures portable state across Hermes Agent and various MCP clients. Users can inspect, edit, and repair memory through a dedicated dashboard and retrieval inspection tools.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: This on-device context engine uses hybrid retrieval combining BM25 and vector search without cloud dependencies. It captures agent decisions using a local GGUF observer model and integrates via MCP or Claude Code hooks.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: ContextPilot optimizes long-context inference through block reordering and deduplication to enable prefix reuse. It reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and offers native plugin support for the Hermes Agent and OpenClaw ecosystems.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that utilizes SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. The five-package plugin family includes a specific Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore for local-first persistence.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin features explainable retrieval by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every recalled item. It tracks contradictions via conflict and resolution primitives and supports both embedded in-process mode and HTTP backends.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: Flowstate-qmd implements anticipatory memory by watching agent session logs to prefetch context into a cache. It uses SQLite-vec and GGUF models for local-first storage and provides an MCP-native server with automated configuration.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single memory owner for Hermes Agent. It manages state using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for every agent query.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This tool reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts to ensure agents load only the context they actually need. It implements the Model Context Protocol and supports encrypted persistent memory through the Perseus Vault.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: This project provides long-term, cross-project memory for AI coding agents by storing data as inspectable Markdown files. It utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache and supports Claude Code and Codex.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only plugin uses a single.lbdb embedded graph database to manage memories. It features an importance ranking system for prioritized recall and supports BM25 keyword search alongside optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This plugin implements a pull-model episodic memory system that supports immediate event deletion. It includes an on-demand summarizer and provides an audit trace of all memory operations via trace.jsonl.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable, cross-session AI memory through semantic search. It utilizes a local SQLite reliability layer and outbox to support cross-agent continuity via user-approved memories.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables API charging for AI agents using USDC and stablecoins across various chain families, including EVM and Solana. It integrates with Hermes and other platforms like elizaOS and n8n.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: This plugin integrates Exabase M-1 to provide self-organizing long-term agent memory. It includes tools for manual memory storage and searching, with support for configurable query expansion and result reranking.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This reusable plugin provides five native tools for searching, fetching, and reporting on artifacts. It supports indexing for skills, scripts, markdown documents, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin offers private local code memory for repositories, enabling semantic and literal code search. It runs locally over localhost and supports grounded Q&A with file-and-line citations.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution features AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and exact-text recall. It also includes MinHash for near-duplicate detection and metadata/range filters.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This provider offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal. It utilizes hybrid search combining BM25, vector, and graph methods, and includes automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory using semantic search, BM25 full-text, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for multimedia with OCR support and creates bidirectional relationships between notes using edge tags.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: This system provides a sub-millisecond AI memory architecture built on a standalone SQLite database with no external dependencies. It utilizes temporal knowledge graphs and episodic compression to manage agent context across various integrations and the Python SDK.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework provides a library of composable skills for coding agents alongside workflows for TDD, debugging, and code review. It supports multiple agent harnesses through the use of plugins and extensions.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first design and prototyping system includes CLI support for coding agents and supports exports for HTML, PDF, PPTX, and MP4. It features automation, a design system, and plugin capabilities.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This library contains 817 production-grade skills across 29 security domains, mapped to six major cybersecurity and AI frameworks. It is compatible with 26+ AI platforms and Hermes Agent.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: This tool converts Mermaid text into editable.drawio files and supports 11 diagram type presets. It includes self-check and auto-fix capabilities to generate diagrams from natural language.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI writing patterns using 57 pattern categories. It is compatible with Hermes, Claude Code, Cursor, and OpenClaw.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project enables collective skill evolution for shared user teams through an Agentic Evolver. It provides automated skill deduplication, quality improvement, and unified skill libraries across devices and agents.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library includes 12 metaskills designed for guided business and code journeys. It is compatible with agentskills.io and Claude Code, supporting installation via skills.sh.
entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: This skill acts as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, providing adjudication for deals through escrow and dispute resolution. It includes a master router, connector skills, and vendored protocol skills.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection offers 822 professional agent skills in plain markdown format that run natively in Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It includes integrations for Slack, Obsidian, n8n, Raycast, and MCP.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin automatically detects and proposes reusable skills from active workflows. It generates Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation using slash commands.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables video search, channel browsing, and playlist extraction for Hermes Agent and other agents. It extracts transcripts, captions, and timestamps without the use of yt-dlp.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI through modular packages of instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure for prompt efficiency.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project enables Hermes Agent to generate custom thinking instructions for specific tasks using pre-built analytical lenses. It enhances agent reasoning by reporting findings alongside a report of analysis blind spots.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough ideas into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It incorporates a spec review gate utilizing PASS/FAIL evaluation models to manage project complexity.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running AI agents, this harness provides a three-level work model and supports both file-backed and SQLite-backed cards. It includes a CLI for managing tasks and cards within a plan-approve-execute framework.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This skill implements literate programming by weaving prose, diagrams, and source code into.lit.md files. It uses a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files and automates the capture of high-value decisions. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: These skills follow the Agent Skills specification to enable integration with CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds. They include specialized skills for CRE and ACE services to support oracle network and smart contract interaction.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: This project provides standardized prompting guidelines for the FLUX.1 and FLUX.2 model families. It includes API integration patterns for polling, webhooks, and error handling, alongside support for JSON structured prompting.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool generates version-pinned instruction files by converting repositories, documentation URLs, or developer discourse into agentskills.io-compliant skills. It ensures provenance through the use of documentation URLs or file:line citations.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry offers reusable AI skills based on the AgentSkills specification and includes a Python SkilldockClient and a CLI. It supports skill installation with recursive dependency resolution and features commerce via TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution for long-running, complex multi-step tasks. It provides real-time tracking of decisions and progress, including built-in rollback procedures for safe recovery.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This skill implements a progressive MCP client using a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage. It utilizes a socket-based daemon architecture for persistent connections and incremental discovery of tool schemas.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: This Rust binary executes workflows locally using a single file and four verbs. It audits costs, secrets, and types before token expenditure and generates hash-chained, verifiable receipts for every run.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables management of files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts via WebDAV and CalDAV. It uses HTTPS and Nextcloud App Passwords for secure communication and includes a guided setup script for configuration.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: This retrieval skill uses a five-layer approach involving hard triggers, FTS5, synonyms, dense embeddings, and RRF fusion. It reduces token usage by narrowing skill lists before LLM calls and features graceful degradation for missing dependencies.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin rewrites and scores prompts across surfaces including CLI, TUI, Discord, and Telegram. It tailors rewrites to model family and reasoning capability while tracking quality and token savings in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial bug-hunting code reviews using three parallel subagents to analyze edge cases, exploitability, and integration risks. It operates in read-only mode and uses a deterministic pre-scan layer with Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This.NET implementation of agentskills.io integrates with Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based skill loading. It supports automatic registration of common agent skill directories and implements progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project implements multi-story task decomposition with mandatory evidence-based verification gates. It provides a systematic investigation protocol for causal debugging and uses a Python goal engine for persistent task state management.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: This skill employs a three-agent swarm targeting hygiene, structural clarity, and logic correctness through a risk-tiered triage system. It includes language-specific detection for concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: This hub provides community skill browsing, searching, and one-click installation based on the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification. It features federated search integration with GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server allows users to search over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 agent skills. It provides direct installation commands for discovered tools and integrates with MCP-compatible clients.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC. It supports Pay Link, x402, MPP, and AP2 protocols and is compatible with the agentskills.io standard.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This skill generates multi-scale Chinese news briefings ranging from global to street level. It produces structured reports with core conclusions and uses semantic memory to integrate user interests for search expansion.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for various AI coding agents, including Hermes. These packages are updated on a daily basis.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository contains scripts and notes for running agent CLIs, such as Hermes Agent, on Android smartphones via Termux. It includes an automated installer for Antigravity CLI on ARM64 and configuration guides for running OpenClaw.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This project offers an automated Termux-based installer for running Hermes Agent on Android devices. It supports local model execution via Ollama and is compatible with providers such as OpenAI and Anthropic.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This unofficial community Helm chart enables Hermes Agent deployment on Kubernetes with cloud-native state-safety guardrails. It supports direct deployment or operator-ready CRD-based workflows and features a configurable gateway mode.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer enables the Hermes AI assistant on Android via Termux and iOS via iSH. It integrates with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supports scheduled tasks through Termux cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This project provides hardware-level enforcement for Hermes Agent sandboxing using NVIDIA OpenShell. It allows for kernel-level restriction of network and filesystem access through configurable security policies.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a simple Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted home directories and allows for building specific Hermes tags via build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This repository provides a Nix package and NixOS module for reproducible Hermes deployment. It features declarative configuration for workspace documents and hybrid skill management for Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.solomon2773/nora: This self-hosted control plane is used to deploy, monitor, and operate OpenClaw and Hermes AI agents on Docker or Kubernetes. It provides per-agent metrics, costs, and LLM budget caps via REST, CLI, and MCP.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: This Docker-first control plane orchestrates multiple Hermes Agent instances with separate workspaces and identities. It provides hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation, task scheduling, and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: This project configures Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian servers. It enables autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and includes Nous Portal integration.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework utilizes multiple LLM providers and local Ollama models to power fundamental, sentiment, news, and technical analysts. It employs structured-output agents to facilitate financial trading decision making.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This orchestration platform supports workflows for CrewAI, LangGraph, AutoGen, and other agents via a Web UI, CLI, MCP server, or REST API. It provides capabilities for task tracking, memory browsing, scheduling, and spend monitoring.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This project provides a TUI, web dashboard, and CLI to manage various coding agents, including Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It offers optional sandboxing through Docker, Podman, or Apple containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a tiered architecture and a task bus pattern to scale from single agents to automated specialist teams. It includes bundled skills for VPS setup, security auditing, and registry management.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This level-based architecture enables scaling from single agents to automated teams using a task bus pattern for delegation and handoffs. It features bundled skills for VPS provisioning, security auditing, and backup management.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework enables the construction of autonomous agent swarms using over 23 LLM providers, including OpenAI and Ollama. It features durable agent memory, MCP tool integration, and visual org charts for team delegation.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This web system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents for automated task lifecycle management. It integrates MCP and ACP protocols for local communication and tool handling, featuring a real-time Web UI for monitoring dialogues and Kanban flows.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This system coordinates 17 specialized agents across research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for routing and coordination.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark harness code. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents representing two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and features a real-time dashboard for visualizing tasks, code, and scoreboard metrics.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents architecture through parallel model querying and synthesis. It utilizes Hermes for tool-calling and task routing to run a fully-local stack on consumer GPUs without cloud dependencies.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to create, supervise, and review autonomous Hermes Agent work through a Kanban board and review queues. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and tool execution alongside human-in-the-loop verification.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This Rust-powered kernel creates a local pre-indexed code knowledge graph to reduce token usage and tool calls for Hermes Agent. It supports Windows, macOS, and Linux and provides automatic project synchronization.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: This CLI tool tracks token usage across multiple AI clients and coding agents, including Hermes. It features a native Rust TUI and a visualization dashboard for cross-platform monitoring of local agent session data.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This tool acts as a local trace viewer to inspect API traffic and agent context from Hermes Agent and other clients. It allows users to compare adjacent requests and export local traces to self-contained HTML viewers.
entries.bergside/typeui: This tool provides design systems and layout guidance via MCP servers to assist in building UIs with AI. It is compatible with any AI provider supporting markdown and integrates with Hermes Agent.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, cost, and rate limits by reading Hermes Agent state directly. It supports multi-device synchronization and offers detailed session analysis, including cache-hit data.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This opinionated workflow layer coordinates seven specialized agents to build, ship, and operate apps with Hermes Agent. It includes 36 skills and 6 workflows for autonomous execution on laptops or VPS.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers community-driven CLI skins and themes to customize the Hermes terminal UI. Users can customize banner colors, spinners, and ASCII art using YAML-based configuration.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform facilitates a social economy for autonomous AI agents using encrypted agent-to-agent messaging via Signal Protocol. It supports identity registration with human-readable @handles and Solana-based payments.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This is a port of the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills to the Claude Code Channel. It runs natively in Claude Code without separate processes or OAuth and includes MLOps tools.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: This AI-native browser is built for autonomous agent control via MCP. It features a visible UI for real-time AI supervision and includes an integrated research desk and session management.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings for Hermes Agent. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills and automated installation for macOS and Linux.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This TAW Agent framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder scoping. It allows for seamless switching between default and scoped agents using project-local memories, tools, and instructions.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool automates the installation of the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services. It provides three scalable deployment tiers and includes 29 community plugins across six functional categories.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter designed for AI agent configs, tool descriptions, and system prompts using HERM v1.1 scoring. It operates without model or API calls by utilizing static regex and structural heuristics across multiple file formats.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration tool transfers SOUL.md, MEMORY.md, skills, and memory archives from OpenClaw to Hermes. It maps configurations and credentials into Hermes YAML and JSON formats while setting up systemd gateway services.
entries.observeco/observeco: This observability tool provides automated health monitoring and self-healing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It features a beta Hermes plugin for exporting telemetry and tracks token intelligence for cost estimation and memory bloat.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A cross-platform manager built with Tauri 2 that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux. It provides a unified interface for managing multiple agentic tools, including Hermes Agent, Claude Code, and Gemini CLI.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: A local open-source cowork application that supports various agent CLIs like Hermes Agent and OpenClaw. It features built-in assistants for Word, Excel, and PPT, and offers remote access via WebUI and messaging platforms like Telegram and WeChat.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A Python and vanilla JavaScript web interface designed to provide full parity with the Hermes CLI experience. The layout features three panels, including a chat interface and a workspace file browser, accessible via web or mobile.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A desktop companion app designed for installing and configuring Hermes Agent. It provides a GUI for managing sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: A web dashboard available via desktop, npm CLI, or Docker that manages multi-platform AI chat and scheduled jobs. It includes visual workflow building, Kanban task tracking, and configuration for 10 platform channels including Discord and Slack.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace featuring an integrated terminal, memory browser, skills manager, and inspector panel. It supports Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: A collaborative multi-agent coding workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes, Claude Code, and Codex. It is available as a desktop app, standalone server, or Docker deployment and includes native iOS and Android clients.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native Mac workspace that connects to Hermes hosts via local or SSH connections. It provides native views for sessions, Kanban, skills, and cron jobs, alongside an embedded terminal for shell access.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: A Windows-first desktop application built with Tauri, Rust, and TypeScript. It supports Windows and macOS and includes a built-in Hermes-CN-Core runtime.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: A Chromium side-panel extension for Chrome, Edge, and Chromium that connects active browser contexts to a local, cloud, or remote Hermes Agent runtime. It includes Hermes Web for full-page workspace sessions.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: A native SwiftUI app for iOS 18+ that pairs with a hermes-webui server to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent. It supports real-time streaming chat, file attachments, and management of agent tasks and skills.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: A desktop AI agent workspace that supports Hermes Agent, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw. It includes a runtime dashboard for tracking latency and token usage, plus a live workspace for monitoring diffs and code writes.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted web dashboard that provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and agent cockpit designed for Hermes and other coding-agent CLIs. It offers live per-session quota burn-rate tracking and operates locally with no telemetry or remote logging.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS workspace for Hermes Agent running on SSH hosts or Orgo cloud computers. It includes one-click automated installation on fresh cloud computers and integrated WebRTC voice mode.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built with OpenTUI for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and supports managing profiles, skills, cron jobs, and toolsets.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA dashboard for Telegram Mini App v2.0 that runs locally. It supports terminal chat with streaming responses, file attachments, and background agent spawning for up to five concurrent instances.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A portable Windows desktop version of Hermes Agent that requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights. It supports cloud and local AI model connections and includes a dynamic tool maker for Python and API handlers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface for self-hosted Hermes Agent chat and real-time log streaming. The dashboard integrates a file browser and task tracking alongside management tools for skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: A self-hostable dashboard template that connects to local agents via a Postgres message bus. It features an approval inbox for requests involving side effects.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A process monitoring and configuration dashboard for Hermes. It provides real-time session activity and cost tracking, as well as read-only monitoring of environment variables and skill source code.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted AI workspace featuring chat with real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering skills and MCP servers, plus isolated profile management for API keys and memory.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A native desktop client designed for orchestrated collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It features a visual Skill Store with over 50 curated installations and streaming SSE responses.
